column1: # Campaign manifest for h200_campaign_queue.sh: EXP-R2-207's R3, the curvature point at d_hidden 4,096.
# Columns, tab-separated: slot <TAB> key <TAB> gpu <TAB> stage <TAB> label <TAB> env <TAB> args
# `--device` and `--out` are injected by the runner and must never appear in args.
# ${TRANSFER_MODEL_BASE_DIR} is substituted in-pod after h200_env.sh is sourced, so the model root stays declared once.
# ONE SNAPSHOT, key `r207`, which must be the freeze at pinned commit bd6ff99 -- the trainer EXP-R2-191 and EXP-R2-204
# ran, byte-identical to 04fdfa5, the code state that trained every baseline these cells are read against.
# CARDS 2 AND 3 ONLY, and this is a constraint of the runner rather than a preference. The queue REFUSES a busy card
# (`refused-busy-gpu`) instead of waiting for it, so a manifest may only name cards that will be free when it is
# dispatched. Cards 0 and 1 carry EXP-R2-207's R2 second pair under the single-cell driver until roughly 15:30, so
# naming them here would turn four cells into four refusals.
# WHY R2's SECOND PAIR IS NOT IN THIS FILE. Both of its cells were dispatched under the driver as cards freed one at a
# time, with the labels r207_r2_base_text_s20260816 and r207_r2_stage1_text_s20260816. They are the same labels the
# retired campaign_r207_r2r3.tsv used, so had that file been dispatched the resume rule would have skipped them
# correctly -- but its card assignments are now wrong, which is the other half of the same hazard. It was deleted.
# SLOTS. Slot 1 is the two protein cells at ~3.7 h; slot 2 the two text cells at ~3.2-3.4 h. Two cards, two slots,
# about 7 h end to end. This is the queue's first real campaign: one dispatch, no further crossing of the transit
# link, and a status file on GPFS that one `cat` reads.
# VOID CONDITIONS carried from EXP-R2-207, unchanged. Protein must realise 36,978 steps / 147,912 sequences /
# 34,001,183 scored tokens with the screen keeping 961 of 1,024 at max containment 1.0000 over 229,376 records; text
# must realise 11,367 / 45,468 / 34,002,081 with 1,024 of 1,024 at 0.4346 over 106,496. `--steps` is the DECLARED
# value, 56,000 protein and 26,000 text, because it sets the held-out offset. The three optimiser flags are omitted
# exactly as the r24_plt_* baselines omitted them, so `compare_matched_training` against the baseline of the same
# configuration must return `disagreements` exactly ["d_hidden"]. Any other disagreement voids the cell.
